description: Review epic created after the Pi connector factory completed the Wave 4-6 connector backlog. The leaf implementation tasks are closed, but review found release-blocking and confidence-blocking issues that should be fixed before treating the generated packages as shippable. Scope: make package tests deterministic, make root warning-as-error verification meaningful, repair Req.Test/Plug setup, eliminate generated-test warnings, close completed parent epics only after verification, and document the expected post-factory release gate. This is intentionally a hardening epic, not new connector feature work.
title: [REVIEW] Harden connector factory output after Wave 4-6 buildout
